metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2016 · La La Land
metas.description: When Sebastian, a pianist, and Mia, an actress, follow their passion and achieve success in their respective fields, they find themselves torn between their love for each other and their careers.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2003 · School of Rock
metas.description: After being kicked out of his rock band, Dewey Finn becomes a substitute teacher of an uptight elementary private school, only to try and turn his class into a rock band.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2012 · Pitch Perfect
metas.description: Beca, a freshman at Barden University, is cajoled into joining The Bellas, her school's all-girls singing group. Injecting some much needed energy into their repertoire, The Bellas take on their male rivals in a campus competition.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1959 · Some Like It Hot
metas.description: After two male musicians witness a mob hit, they flee the state in an all-female band disguised as women, but further complications set in.
